facts.activity_file: working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions

control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
positive communication before approaching mobile equipment
segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment

facts.title: regulator directive concerning lock out tag out at G-8102

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 3 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_COMMUNICATION_BEFORE_APPROACH: the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment had been bypassed, and the root cause analysis classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control PROXIMITY_DETECTION_AND_SEGREGATION: the segregation of light vehicles and pedestrians from heavy equipment was not in place, and the root cause analysis classified this as an organisational factor.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on G-8102 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the positive communication before approaching mobile equipment on G-8102 and record the field verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in operating in reduced visibility, specifically working in dust, darkness and weather restrictions. G-8102 (gas turbine generators) is in service for on-site generation. The task proceeded during routine operation while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was not in place. The kinetic energy involved is held as rotating equipment, and the recorded presentation was entanglement, impact, crush.
response.summary: On 10 May 2010 a regulatory notice was issued concerning G-8102 at Tolgarra Processing and Power Station following routine operation.
